# Set Symmetric Difference

![Set Symmetric Difference function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/collection/set/14-symmetric-difference.svg)

[Collection functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Returns values present in exactly one input Set. Equal inputs produce a typed empty Set. Search also accepts Set Symmetric Difference.vim.
